decision: The current replay contract verifies a shared node-query limit only. Do not claim the 2.0-second per-query training limit is enforced for evaluation: no task2636 runner exists. Before registration, bind the intended evaluation time policy explicitly in the runner and tests or state that evaluation relies only on its cumulative stage/lifetime cap. No evaluation search was run.

evaluation_node_limit_binding.basis: FrozenSlotReplayContext passes training.search.nodes_per_query into replay_slot_history; focused tests bind requested_nodes=2048.

evaluation_seconds_per_query_binding.basis: The replay adapter has no search invocation and no seconds_per_query input. The task2625 reference evaluator consumes plan.search.seconds_per_query, but that separate runner does not implement task2636.
